verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers documents version history and rollback for Workers: you can roll back to a previously deployed version via the dashboard or the `wrangler rollback` command. This covers the versioning and rollback parts of the story for Worker-based automations. The review step is only implied by the claim that Workers fit into Git and GitHub Actions workflows; no product-side review or approval flow for deployments is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented review/diff or approval step for automation changes, explicit version-listing documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: You can roll back to a previously deployed version of your Worker using Wrangler or the Cloudflare dashboard.
To roll back to a specified version of your Worker via Wrangler, use the [`wrangler rollback`](/workers/wrangler/commands/general/#rollback) command.
Fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework.
